from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, status
from selenium.webdriver.remote.webdriver import WebDriver
from pydantic import BaseModel

router = APIRouter(prefix="/automation/sessions")

class DomCaptureResponse(BaseModel):
    session_id: str
    current_url: str
    page_source: str

@router.post("/{session_id}/capture-dom", response_model=DomCaptureResponse)
async def capture_remote_session_dom(
    session_id: str,
    grid_manager: SeleniumGridManager = Depends(get_grid_manager),
    user: AuthUser = Depends(get_authenticated_user)
):
    remote_session = grid_manager.get_active_session(session_id)
    if not remote_session:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="Active browser session not found on grid")

    if remote_session.owner_org_id != user.organization_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN, detail="Unauthorized access to grid session")

    driver: WebDriver = remote_session.driver
    source = driver.page_source
    url = driver.current_url

    return DomCaptureResponse(
        session_id=session_id,
        current_url=url,
        page_source=source
    )
